page10_section7_7.conditions: DVDD2.7–5.25V, specified20pF ||100kohm DOUT load over specified ambient range; actual board parasitics not measured by this review.

datasheet.page66_section9_4_4_2: DOUT changes on SCLK rising; DIN is latched falling; SCLK must return low. Glitches/ringing can advance interface state.
datasheet.page67_section9_4_4_5: TIMEOUT bit3 disables/enables the byte autoreset. Disabled permits software-preemption pause without relying on a minimum clock frequency; it does not validate signal integrity.

stage_review.finding: Dedicated exact board bus/device callback, no cold-presence busy/quarantine, same ADS mutex, confirmed INTERFACE0x06/STATUS+CRC/TIMEOUT0 remain required. These are state predicates, not elapsed-C-delay assumptions.

Persistent55-bit descriptor and>=8B buffers. Only ESP_OK plus exact descriptor result clears in-flight and permits GPIO takeover. Timeout/mismatch quarantines with no takeover. SDK returns completed descriptor after completion queue processing; no timeout-as-cancellation assumption.

SCLK is checked low before ROM output-route handoff; GPIO output latch was preloaded low atline516. There is no separate low hold after route handoff before gpio_set_level(high). The current O2 object retains completion, time, frequency, GPIO read and ROM-call work, but their API contract does not specify a40ns minimum delay. This is a source-level guarantee gap, not evidence of an observed short pulse or an O2-caused CRC failure.

On successful high write, an explicit esp_rom_delay_us(1) precedes high readback and real MISO read. Existing O2 object retains argument1 and ROM call. This establishes software delay by API rather than by Og instruction overhead; extra timestamp/ISR/preemption time is not used as the minimum.

stage_review.stage: fall to restore / next-clock low width
stage_review.finding: Explicit esp_rom_delay_us(1) after low write precedes low verification and SPI route restoration; success and error cleanup retain this delay in O2 object. The next SPI command cannot start through this owner before mutex release.

Route fields and low level are re-read; incomplete frame/restore quarantines, original error retained. GPIO register/level readback is software/digital state evidence, not proof of glitch-free analog waveform.

optimization_conclusion.rom_delay: ESP32-S3 API aliases esp_rom_delay_us to fixed ROM ets_delay_us0x40000600. Application-O2 cannot shorten it by optimizing a C busy loop. SDK notes CPU tick calibration is required; current CPU160MHz/PM-off and RTC clock setter updates calibration. Not using the unrelated C5/C61 RISC-V delay patch as S3 evidence.
optimization_conclusion.gpio_access: SDK GPIO LL uses volatile MMIO set/clear and input registers. Actual O2 object keeps external GPIO/ROM calls; reads and writes are not optimized into cached ordinary memory.
optimization_conclusion.max_spi_phase: Hardware SPI mode1 and configuredmax2MHz imply nominal500ns period/250ns half periods for the hardware portion; these are programmed timings, not scope measurements.
optimization_conclusion.remaining_gap: Before the final manual rising edge, the40ns low pulse requirement is not represented by an explicit delay after verified GPIO-low handoff. Do not claim a universal compiler/API-independent bound from function-call overhead.
optimization_conclusion.next_minimal_action: Root authorized a separate minimal patch after this report freezes: verify low after handoff, explicitly hold low with ROM-delay granularity before the final rise. Preserve both existing1us waits, CRC, sampled data and source provenance; test ordering and failure containment. This closes a source guarantee gap, not proof the previous hardware violated timing.

physical_limits: No oscilloscope/logic-analyzer waveform was inspected; digital GPIO readback cannot establish absence of sub-cycle glitches or ringing.
The60ns DOUT bound applies to datasheet voltage/load conditions; actual pad/trace capacitance and thresholds remain unmeasured.
Zero CRC in a finite capture does not prove electrical timing or all future operating conditions.
Scheduler preemption can extend pauses; the transaction deadline remains a containment budget, not a microsecond physical waveform guarantee.
status: REVIEW_FROZEN: explicit sample/restore delays survive O2; pre-rise low guard gap identified without claiming observed electrical failure
